falsification_conditions.condition: BTC/USD closes above $73,500 on any daily candle within the next 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A close above the August 2024 high would break the lower-high structure that defines the bottom_2024_aug pattern, invalidating the HOLD signal and suggesting the bottom is already in with upside continuation

falsification_conditions.condition: Total crypto market cap (excluding BTC/ETH) increases by more than 15% from current level while BTC dominance drops below 52%
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Broad altcoin outperformance with BTC dominance falling would indicate risk-on rotation and speculative appetite, contradicting the late-stage bottoming thesis that expects continued BTC dominance and alt underperformance

falsification_conditions.condition: Funding rates on BTC perpetual swaps turn positive (>0.01% per 8h) and stay positive for 5 consecutive days while open interest rises above $18B
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: Persistent positive funding with rising open interest signals leveraged longs piling in, which is characteristic of a blowoff top or early bull phase, not a bottoming structure that requires washed-out leverage and neutral-to-negative funding

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
